lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg4Mn2Zn4O16 (Mg2MnZn2O8) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over eight independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mn in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Mg adopts a five-vertex coordination polyhedron. Corner-sharing is observed between Mn octahedra and Mg polyhedra, between Mn octahedra and Zn polyhedra, and among Mg polyhedra, alongside edge-sharing between Mg polyhedra and edge-sharing between Mn octahedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites.
